record.hypothesis: Replace pairwise softplus loss with equal-weight positive and negative binary logistic losses: softplus(-positive_score) + softplus(negative_score), averaged over valid target positions. Unlike a loss depending only on score differences, this also constrains absolute logits and may reduce score drift with tied item embeddings. Keep the existing sampled pairs, masking, HSTU model, readout, optimizer, scheduler and training schedule unchanged.
